segments.text: Alguns Itens e Habilidades permitem que Aventureiros e Combatentes alterem a ordem das cartas na Trilha de Iniciativa. Quando isso acontecer, lembre-se de que o turno de uma miniatura
é ignorado. A miniatura que estiver mais próxima da frente da Trilha de Iniciativa e ainda não tiver realizado seu turno

candidates.proposalText: Alguns Itens e Habilidades permitem que Aventureiros e Combatentes alterem a ordem das cartas na Trilha de Iniciativa. Quando isso acontecer, lembre-se de que o turno de uma miniatura nunca é ignorado. A miniatura que estiver mais próxima da frente da Trilha de Iniciativa e ainda não tiver realizado seu turno sempre agirá em seguida.
candidates.sourceText: •	Some Items and Abilities allow Adventurers and Combatants to manipulate the order of the cards on the Initiative Track. When this happens, it is important to remember that a figure’s turn is never skipped. The figure closest to the front of the Initiative Track that has not yet had a turn will always take their turn next. •	As soon as a figure is Defeated they must immediately remove their corresponding Initiative Card(s) from the Initiative Track. When this happens, the other Initiative Cards collapse to fill in the empty space.  See Being Defeated Pg. 69.•	Some Combatants with multiple figures may share one or more Initiative Cards. We call these Groups. A Group's corresponding Initiative Card is only ever removed from the Initiative Track when the last figure in the Group is Defeated. See Activation Numbers and Groups Pg. 56.•	When a Group starts its turn, each figure that is on the board and in that Group will take a turn, starting with the figure who has the lowest Activation Number. Once the last figure associated with the Group has taken their turn, continue to the next Initiative Card on the Track.•	Some Combatants have multiple Initiative Cards. A Combatant with multiple Initaitive Cards of the same Group Number and/or name will take a turn each time its Initaitive Card would normally give it a turn. •	Don't forget to shuffle the Initiative Track at the start of every new round!

candidates.sourceText: Starting with the Initiative Card closest to the front and moving backwards, Adventurers and Combatants take their turns. After the round ends, shuffle all the Initiative Cards and simply repeat the process again until the Encounter reaches an End Condition.
